stages.name: Welcome & Smart Router
stages.reply: menu (ghee / honey / order / track / team) or direct product route

stages.name: Ghee Enquiry
stages.reply: brand video link + product text + pack list (live Shopify prices, WhatsApp offers)

stages.name: Product Selection
stages.reply: pack confirmation + quantity buttons; unavailable / coming-soon / restricted products never quoted

stages.name: Saved Address Confirmation
stages.reply: masked saved address (area…, city – PIN) + Haan / Badalna hai / Baad mein; full address only after Haan

stages.name: Address Update
stages.reply: parse one-message address (6-digit PIN + city required) -> reconfirm

stages.name: Live Quotation
stages.reply: Shopify draftOrderCalculate: price, GST-inclusive tax, cheapest shipping rate, stock/policy; no rate -> not serviceable

stages.name: Secure Payment Link
stages.reply: draft order (idempotent on quote_ref) + Shopify invoice URL (Razorpay via Shopify checkout)

stages.name: Payment Verification
stages.reply: only after gateway SUCCESS SALE/CAPTURE + amount/variant/qty match; manual 'mark as paid' ignored; replay -> duplicate

stages.name: Shopify Order Confirmation
stages.reply: order number + amount; outbox send_message service job (GuardedSender)

stages.name: Shipping & Tracking
stages.reply: awb_created / in_transit / out_for_delivery / delivered from Shopify fulfillment events; never 'shipped' at label

stages.name: Delivery Exception / NDR
stages.reply: internal task for Dispatch team; no automated customer message until a human confirms

stages.name: Cancellation & Returns
stages.reply: order marked cancelled, promos cancelled, Shiprocket-verify task; fulfillment on a cancelled order -> ALERT

stages.name: Human Agent Handoff
stages.reply: acknowledgement + private note (team Sales / Payment Review / Cow Desk); engine silent while assignee set

stages.name: Lead Tagging & CRM
stages.reply: lead table (contact, product, stage) + labels returned on each turn for the console

stages.name: Customer Preferences & Consent
stages.reply: promotional consent withdrawn; service messages only
